actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.web_search.props.count.descripti: Number of results to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.
actions.web_search.props.exclude.descrip: Exclude specific domains from search results. Separate multiple domains with | or , (max 100).
actions.web_search.props.freshness.descr: Filter results by time range. Defaults to no limit.
actions.web_search.props.include.descrip: Limit search to specific domains. Separate multiple domains with | or , (max 100).
actions.web_search.props.summary.descrip: Include a text summary for each search result.
auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Bocha API Key:

1. Visit [Bocha AI Open Platform](https://open.bochaai.com) and create an account.
2. Navigate to **API KEY Management** in the dashboard.
3. Copy your API key.
